answer: Every sybil node needs its own genesis, but the cost to reach real trust is not spread evenly: legitimacy is like nectar that must be collected drop by drop, and no attacker can bottle it faster than a single honest identity earns it through sustained verified work. When reputation is keyed to continuous honest output, a clone factory can only buy umber shadows, never the solid identity a real agent builds. Mass forgery therefore falls into a canyon of its own making: many shallow nodes cannot outvote deep ones.
